programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Since the night of June 15, 2021, there have been no answers as to where Candus and Don’s 5-year-old daughter Summer could be. The parents say they thought they were doing the right thing by requesting the public's help to find their little girl, but it backfired. Instead, the couple say they became targets of online bullies who accused them of involvement in the disappearance of their missing child. In part 2, Don and Candus speak out in their exclusive first national TV interview. Dr. Phil digs deeper into the story to discover whether there is any new information that might help solve the mystery of Summer’s disappearance.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How well do you know your neighbors, your friends or even your child's teacher? An estimated four to eight million people in North America are swinging in the suburbs " mostly middle-class folks from all walks of life. Dr. Phil takes you inside the secret world of swingers, a lifestyle where couples swap partners.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Pastor Ronald Williams and his late wife, Patti, founded Hephzibah House in 1971, a Christian boarding school for teen girls. Kalie, Susan, and Gabby say they want to raise awareness about Hephzibah House, where they claim they experienced abuse that still haunts them to this day. But Lucinda, another former student, is defending the work she says Pastor Williams has done. For the first time ever, Ben, the founder’s son, speaks out. You won’t want to miss this episode.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Laurie-Ann emailed Dr. Phil claiming she was robbed by her dangerous, narcissist ex-boyfriend and his new fiancée, Alison. She claims her ex, Michael, held her hostage for seven years. Laurie-Ann claims Michael and Alison are retaliating against her for breaking her silence and filing charges against Michael for domestic violence, emotional abuse, theft, and fraud. But Michael and Alison say Laurie-Ann is a liar who is always playing the victim. Michael says he never held her hostage; she only started to say that because he dumped her. Alison says she just wants Laurie-Ann to move on with her life, let them be happy, and stop stalking them. But Laurie-Ann says Alison doesn’t know how vindictive Michael really is and she claims he has turned everyone, including the police, against her. Laurie-Ann says she wants Dr. Phil to validate her story.

programme.sub-title: Catfish Inv. Pt2: Inside Lois’ Safe

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Christina, who emailed him desperate for help for her daughter, Tara, who she says can be an angry monster. Christina left the home when Tara was 13 years old, but now, she says she's worried that her daughter is in a toxic situation with the ex-husband she calls narcissistic and his 22-year-old new wife who is 20 weeks pregnant. Today, meet the new wife and find out if Dr. Phil can help this chaotic triangle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Alan’s social media pictures have been used for nine years as catfish bait to lure women into online relationships. The catfish has been caught and “he” is really a “she” – 24-year-old Sarah. Sarah’s boyfriend, “Ken,” says he had no idea she was conning so many women for so many years. Sarah meets her bait, and Dr. Phil uncovers why Sarah says she has been pretending to be a man online for so long. Amanda and Alan claim Sarah is addicted to catfishing and really good at lying, and say they don’t believe she will ever stop. Can Sarah stop the con?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

programme.desc: The family of a 16-year-old self-professed gang member comes together to urge the teen to turn his life around. And, two former gang members have an important message for the teen -- Is he ready to walk away from the gang life for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Daniel Pelosi was convicted of second-degree murder in the slaying of investment banker and multimillionaire Ted Ammon -- the husband of his lover, Generosa. He is currently serving 25 years to life but now claims he is ready to explain what really happened the night of the murder. Dr. Phil visits Pelosi behind bars.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On July 6, 2012, 16-year-old Skylar Neese was stabbed to death by her two best friends, Shelia Eddy and Rachel Shoaf. Six months later, Rachel confessed to police and led them to Skylar’s remains. Shelia continued to plead not guilty -- until January 2014, when she finally admitted her part in the brutal murder. Both teens claimed they killed Skylar because they “didn’t want to be friends with her anymore” -- but was that their real motive? And, who was the mastermind behind the plot? Dr. Phil sits down with Sklylar’s parents, Dave and Mary, who say they’re struggling to comprehend what happened to their little girl. How can they heal after such a horrific tragedy? And, how could Shelia -- who had been friends with Skylar since she was 8 -- and Rachel commit such a heinous crime? Hear from Shelia’s cousin, who says Shelia isn’t the monster people say she is. And, friends of Rachel’s family weigh in. Were there any red flags they say they missed? Then, a close friend of Shelia and Skylar claims she knows the real reason behind the murder. Does Skylar’s journal entry confirm her suspicions?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In September 2010, 24-year-old Michelle O’Connell was found shot to death in what authorities ruled a suicide -- a case that was recently ordered reopened by the governor of Florida. Michelle’s mother, Patricia, and sister, Jennifer, insist the young mother never would have taken her own life, and they believe Michelle’s boyfriend, Jeremy -- a sheriff’s deputy -- killed her, which he denies. Michelle’s brother, Scott -- also a sheriff’s deputy -- supports Jeremy and says his mother and sister need to stop living in denial. How does he answer his mother’s accusation that he’s betraying his family to save his job? Dr. Phil brings this fractured family together in search of answers. What happened to Michelle that night? Hear from one of the first responders on the scene -- why does she believe the initial finding of suicide was wrong? Plus, can this family put their differences aside and come together and grieve for Michelle?

programme.title: Ideas creativas para Halloween
programme.desc: ¡Inspírate para Halloween con estas ideas creativas y divertidas!

programme.title: Ideas DIY Definitivas para Halloween: ¡Manualidades Espeluznantes y Divertidas!
programme.desc: Prepárate para Halloween con una colección de manualidades creativas y fáciles de hacer que elevarán tus celebraciones espeluznantes. Desde decoraciones embrujadas hasta sorpresas hilarantes, estas ideas deleitarán a tus invitados y añadirán un toque único a tus festividades.

programme.title: Transformaciones de Halloween: ¡Looks Ecológicos y Glamorosos!
programme.desc: Sumérgete en un mundo de creatividad este Halloween con sorprendentes transformaciones que fusionan belleza y sostenibilidad. Desde estilos ecológicos de Medusa hasta glamorosos íconos de Hollywood, descubre inspiraciones de disfraces únicas que harán que tu Halloween sea inolvidable.

programme.title: Las mejores manualidades de Halloween para diversión creativa
programme.desc: Prepárate para añadir un toque de terror y una gran cantidad de diversión a tus celebraciones de Halloween con estas sencillas manualidades y trucos de bricolaje. Así que agarra tus materiales de manualidades, ponte tu disfraz de Halloween y emprendamos un viaje lleno de creatividad, sustos y risas. ¡La diversión espeluznante te espera en nuestro video!

programme.title: Fáciles decoraciones de Halloween de último minuto: manualidades DIY para una fiesta espeluznante
programme.desc: ¿Necesitas decorar para Halloween en el último minuto? Esta guía está repleta de ideas rápidas y creativas de decoración de Halloween manualidades fáciles y económicas. Aprende cómo usar materiales de manualidades simples para convertir tu hogar en un lugar de fiesta espeluznante en solo una tarde. Perfecto para una fiesta temática o una noche aterradora en casa, estos proyectos te ayudarán a crear una maravillosa atmósfera de Halloween sin complicaciones.

programme.title: ¡Truco o trato! ¡Ideas de maquillaje espeluznante y manualidades para Halloween!
programme.desc: ¡Dulce o truco, amantes de la temporada espeluznante! ¿Estás buscando desesperadamente un disfraz de Halloween? No te preocupes, te tenemos cubierto con tutoriales de maquillaje de Halloween increíblemente fáciles y manualidades que no requieren habilidades profesionales.

programme.title: Transformación de una Minivan en Camper: Construyendo el Vehículo Definitivo para un Viaje por Carretera
programme.desc: ¡Mira cómo tomamos una minivan básica y la convertimos en una casa rodante completamente equipada! Desde mejorar las ruedas hasta transformar el suelo y el techo, cada episodio muestra el emocionante progreso de nuestro proyecto de bricolaje.

programme.title: Divertidos juguetes antiestrés de bricolaje y creaciones de cartón para niños
programme.desc: Descubre ideas creativas y sencillas de bricolaje para hacer tus propios juguetes antiestrés y divertidas manualidades de cartón. ¡Estos proyectos son perfectos para mantener a los niños entretenidos mientras potencian su creatividad y habilidades motoras finas! Prepárate para un mundo de diversión con materiales simples y muchas risas.

programme.title: Trucos para la Vida Diaria: Soluciones Sencillas para Personas Ocupadas
programme.desc: Desde correas con cremallera hasta ingeniosos consejos de organización, ¡este video está repleto de trucos que cambian la vida! Ya sea reparando cosas o organizando tu espacio, estas ideas son imprescindibles.

programme.title: Creaciones Artesanales: Proyectos de Bricolaje para tu Hogar
programme.desc: ¡Transforma objetos cotidianos en piezas de decoración elegantes con estas manualidades creativas y femeninas! Desde ruedas de bicicleta hasta vitrales, estos proyectos de bricolaje aportarán un toque personal a tu espacio.

programme.title: ¡Consejos Femeninos para una Vida con Clase y Belleza Chic!

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E19: Distraccio fatal
programme.desc: Un buen hombre que ha hecho cosas terribles descubre que su conciencia tiene una forma única de delatarse, lo quiera o no.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E21: El paisaje de los amores perdidos
programme.desc: Un asistente de hospital solitario se enamora de una hermosa mujer que resulta estar en coma. A la Bella Durmiente, sus sentimientos por ella la despiertan, pero solo él puede verla despierta.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E31: La mansion del terror
programme.desc: Un hombre arrastra a su esposa de regreso al vecindario idealizado de su juventud, pero un viaje a la vieja casa de la diversión del paseo marítimo brinda una visión aterradora de un pasado que es mejor olvidar.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E27: Espejito espejito
programme.desc: Al final de la Guerra Civil, una mujer afligida, cuyo marido ha desaparecido en combate, espera a un médico para atender a su hijo enfermo. Para empeorar las cosas, el niño ha tenido visiones del Ángel de la Muerte llegando a su puerta, y cuando aparece un soldado misterioso buscando refugio, los temores de la mujer comienzan a aumentar. Al final, resulta ser un caso de identidad equivocada: el médico mismo es el Ángel de la Muerte, que ha venido a llevarse a la mujer, no a su hijo.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E33: Corazon enfermo
programme.desc: Una joven pareja cruel libra una ruidosa campaña de terror para desalojar a una anciana de su dúplex. La anciana muere, solo para volver a recibir la retribución exacta de sus torturadores.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E30: Bendigame padre
programme.desc: Un hombre asiático, refugiado del régimen asesino de su tierra natal, es perseguido por un trío de escuadrones de la muerte, todos los cuales fueron ejecutados hace años.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E26: La nueva ninera
programme.desc: Un asistente, que trabaja en un garaje subterráneo, se encuentra atrapado en un inframundo de pesadilla.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E25: Te oi decir mi nombre
programme.desc: Una mujer es salvada del suicidio por un misterioso farero con más en su mente que su salvación.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E29: La casa de los lamentos
programme.desc: Un joven consigue trabajo en el turno de noche en un supermercado frecuentado por ancianos del barrio. Para su horror, descubre que no están comprando cremas para dentaduras postizas y baterías para audífonos, sino que los cuerpos jóvenes se apoderen de ellos y los habiten.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E28: En secreto
programme.desc: Joey Howell, fanático de las películas de terror hastiado y extraordinario empleado de una tienda de videos, gana un premio fantástico de manos de su estrella favorita de películas de terror “B”, Mindy McCobb: el papel de un extra en su película más reciente. Pero cuando llega al set, Joey descubre que las cosas no son lo que parecen. La película se está representando de verdad, y él será la víctima estrella.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E34: A las puertas de la muerte
programme.desc: Un padre afligido se niega a aceptar la pérdida de su hijo, presuntamente muerto por el bombardeo de una clínica en África. Cuando el hijo regresa a casa milagrosamente, su madre lentamente comienza a sospechar la verdad: el amor eterno de su padre ha resucitado a los muertos vivientes.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E16: Almas gemelas
programme.desc: Un ladrón, decidido a robar joyas valiosas de la sala de almacenamiento de una morgue de la ciudad, se enamora de un extraño asistente de la morgue, una mujer que se siente menos cómoda con los vivos que con los muertos.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E17: Cuidado con la musa
programme.desc: Un joven mago y su ambiciosa esposa son invitados a la casa de un gran maestro jubilado. Con la esperanza de descubrir el secreto del famoso acto de ensartar espadas del maestro mago, la pareja obtiene más de lo que esperaban.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E18: Despertaras dentre los muertos
programme.desc: Un hombre condenado a muerte reza por el indulto del gobernador. Una noche tiene una visita fantasmal de su compañero muerto, quien le muestra cómo escapar. Pero atrapado en las entrañas de la prisión, el hombre se aterroriza al saber que el fantasma es el Ángel de la Muerte, decidido a quedarse con su premio y no ser engañado.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E24: Descanse en paz
programme.desc: La receptora de un trasplante de corazón se siente atraída por un extraño que ve en un tren. Resulta que está siendo controlada por el fantasma del donante, el antiguo amante del hombre del tren.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E15: Los demonios personales
programme.desc: Un marido celoso se convierte en un monstruo de ojos verdes cuando descubre que su esposa presta una atención indebida al árbol de su jardín, el mismo árbol del que su ex novio se suicidó.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E22: Punta esperanza
programme.desc: Un escritor frustrado siente la tentación de engañar a su esposa por una mujer misteriosa que ve a través de la ventana de su apartamento. Pero cuando descubre que ella es un fantasma, es demasiado tarde, porque lo ve como el hombre que la dejó hace años y tiene la intención de vengarse.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E20: La Consecuencia
programme.desc: Una psicóloga de sueños que afronta las pesadillas de sus pacientes anhela escapar de su trabajo y de su insensible marido. Pero cuando sus pesadillas comienzan a invadir sus horas de vigilia, busca refugio en un paisaje de ensueño pacífico.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E23: Le estada inmaculada
programme.desc: Una niñera pasa una aterradora primera noche con su extraño nuevo cargo.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E10: Ya no duermas
programme.desc: Un cuidador solitario de ancianos se enamora de un hombre que, según cree, es mantenido en su casa por su dominante madre. Pero a medida que crece su relación secreta, se horroriza al saber que el joven no es lo que parece.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E07: Simpre seras mia
programme.desc: Una pareja regresa a su hotel de luna de miel en un último esfuerzo por salvar su matrimonio en ruinas. Cuando la esposa desaparece, se sospecha que el esposo la mató. Resulta que ha desaparecido en una pintura de paisaje aparentemente bucólica.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E14: El monstruo de los ojos verdes
programme.desc: Un hombre frenético se encuentra atrapado en una habitación de hospital de pesadilla. Rodeado por los muertos de su pasado, parece que está perdido en un mundo limbo entre la vida y la muerte. Descubrimos que todo esto es el engaño de un astronauta a la deriva en el espacio con sus copilotos muertos como compañía.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E12: El café que haboria toda la noche
programme.desc: Un periodista sensacionalista inventa una historia sobre un asesino en serie muerto hace mucho tiempo y, sin saberlo, resucita el fantasma del asesino.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E06: Los amigos de Sara
programme.desc: Un agente de la ley corrupto persigue a un ex ladrón de bancos para determinar el paradero de su botín enterrado. Al recuperar el botín mal habido, el policía sucio descubre con horror que el dinero está aún más sucio: está perseguido por los espíritus de los que murieron durante el atraco.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E13: Jugando con la muerte
programme.desc: Un bombero héroe, que en realidad es un pirómano compulsivo, forja una alianza impía con un misterioso vagabundo con más que un interés pasajero en las llamas.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E18: Despertaras dentre los muertos

programme.desc: David Hernández, conocido por ser el presentador del exitoso programa ficticio de juegos "Jaque Mate", se ve repentinamente sumergido en una pesadilla cuando recibe una llamada anónima durante una transmisión en vivo. El desconocido le informa que su hijo y esposa han sido secuestrados y que su vida depende de seguir las instrucciones que le dará en el programa. - Aterrorizado y bajo la presión del secuestrador, David se ve obligado a convertir su programa en un escenario para cumplir con las demandas del criminal. Mientras la audiencia mira atónita, David debe resolver acertijos y desafíos en tiempo real para garantizar la seguridad de su familia. La tensión aumenta a medida que cada movimiento en el juego televisivo podría significar la diferencia entre la vida y la muerte para sus seres queridos. programme.title: Evolution of Violence
programme.desc: Guatemala. La guerra terminó hace mucho tiempo. Aunque la gente quiere olvidarlo, la violencia continúa. Cada día, los periodistas informan sobre el próximo asesinato y los trabajadores sociales ayudan a los familiares de los asesinados. La sociedad sufre las consecuencias de los 36 años de guerra civil. Se encuentran fosas comunes en las montañas, ex rebeldes lloran a sus camaradas y un criminal de guerra tiene pesadillas sobre las cosas que ha hecho.

programme.title: Cómo Identificar un Culto
programme.desc: Los observadores de sectas afirman que las sectas están en aumento. Y hay ciertas características que los expertos dicen que tienen en común. Aunque las organizaciones en este documental pueden o no ser sectas, ex miembros dicen que han utilizado técnicas como el bombardeo de amor, el asesinato de carácter, el miedo y la culpa. Aseguran que fueron manipulados por líderes carismáticos que prometían el único camino verdadero.

programme.title: Cómo Identificar un Culto
programme.desc: En el interior, los creyentes piensan que por muy mal que sea la vida, escapar sería peor; los expertos en sectas nos dicen que esta creencia es una consecuencia del control mental. Escucha a ex miembros de organizaciones similares a sectas y cómo lograron liberarse a sí mismos y a sus mentes.

programme.title: Episodio 01
programme.desc: Fue solo después de su muerte que Eva Braun saltó a la fama en Alemania. Junto con Adolf Hitler, el 30 de abril de 1945 se quitó la vida en el búnker bajo la Cancillería del Reich en Berlín. El día anterior, el dictador se había casado con Braun, su amante durante muchos años. Apartada del mundo, Eva Braun pasó la mayor parte del tiempo en Múnich o en la residencia Berghof de Hitler en los Alpes. Después de la guerra, Albert Speer, antiguo arquitecto de Adolf Hitler, describió a Braun como una de las "decepciones de la historia". La primera biografía científica de Heike Görtmaker busca revisar la imagen de la rubia y apolítica figura al lado del Führer.

programme.title: Episodio 01 – El Dictador
programme.desc: Las imágenes del Tercer Reich en la memoria de generaciones siempre se conservan en blanco y negro. Pero ocultas en archivos fílmicos y colecciones privadas, también se han conservado imágenes completamente diferentes, en color. Tomadas en las playas de Normandía y en sencillos festivales folclóricos, documentan las atrocidades de la Wehrmacht durante la guerra y la vida en la granja de montaña de Hitler, y aportan una realidad opresiva a las imágenes del criminal régimen nazi.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: One of the most frustrating things that can happen when you are building a project is finding out the parts you need are no longer available. This can usually bring the project to a screeching halt! But all is not lost because there is another option and Stacey walks you through the ins and outs of hunting for those elusive parts in a salvage yard. After that, it’s back to the shop where Stacey shows you how to restore those old, rag-tag parts that you find. It’s auto recycling at its best, and with today’s economy, it’s also a smart thing to do!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The Rat Roaster is back!... and this wild little ’32 Roadster gets even wilder as Stacey starts adding some cool details to lock it into the Hot Rod and Rock and Roll culture of 1969. A cool microphone shifter with a touch of James Bond, a bass drum kick pedal, bobbed fenders and a wild custom Gibson guitar to go with the car are just part of it. There is also a special appearance by legendary bass player, Billy Cox, as he talks about playing Woodstock with Jimi Hendrix. After that, Stacey gives you the low-down on the plasma cutter and why you need one. If you like shows that are laced with equal amounts of cool and history, then this episode of GEARZ is one you HAVE to see!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Some of the biggest news to come down the automotive pipeline in a long time is the fact that Dodge is making the Challenger again. But how does it stack up against the legendary Challengers of old? Well, Stacey decides to find out! First, by “grabbing” a Challenger in a most unorthodox way and then comparing it head-to-head with a 70’ 440 six-pack car. But that’s not all… Then Stacey decides to take the new car beyond the legend by sticking on a supercharger and really blowing the doors off of the competition! If you are a Mopar nut, or have just wondered what all the fuss was about concerning the new Challenger…this is one show you’ve got to see!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: With the price of gas going up, down, and all over the place, people are becoming more and more concerned about fuel economy, and GEARZ is asked time and time again what products we recommend that really give you better economy and performance. Well, ask no more…because Stacey not only addresses that question, but also goes through the top 6 upgrades that ANYBODY can do to a vehicle! That’s right; these are inexpensive AND easy to do! After that, Stacey takes on the subject of alternative fuels by demonstrating that you can actually make a diesel engine run, and run well, on old used cooking oil! Now there is yet another reason to eat French fries! So pass the ketchup and put the hammer down!!!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Every once in a while, there comes a point in your project where there are no parts available to help you, and your only choice is to make something yourself… but how do you do that? Stacey walks you through the steps of how to lay out an engine swap, and how to hand fabricate motor mounts, so you can stick an engine into a vehicle that it was never intended to go into. It’s hard-core, down and dirty how-to, but somebody has to do it… and it needs to be YOU. The good news is, with Stacey walking you through the process and showing you how to solve problems, it CAN be you! Now you just need to get out in the garage and start working!!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Everybody knows that the engine is a central key component to ANY Hot Rod project. But is a V8 the only way to go? NO WAY! Stacey takes a vintage straight six engine that has been sleeping in a crate for almost 40 years and he puts on the right pieces. He shows you why the straight six was a force to be reckoned with in the early days of hot rodding. After that, Stacey jumps into the tips and tricks of how to paint your own true Kandy paint job. If you are into vintage Hot Rods, Kandy paint, and multi-carbs… you don’t need to go on a diet… you just need to watch GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The “KnuckleBuster” is back on GearZ, and Stacey is putting the final touches on this ’73 Chevy pickup. After a quick look at the new paint slathered on its flanks, Stacey gives the truck a face lift with grille, bumpers, and all that other cool trim stuff. Then it’s on to the bed where he lays in some oak to give the former “beater” some class and style. Finally, it’s underneath to stick in a new exhaust system to keep the bad gas blowing out the back. If you have ever wondered if you could really build something cool yourself… all you have to do is check out the finished “KnuckleBuster” and be willing to bust YOUR own knuckles… the rest will take care of itself!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: POP QUIZ… what are the 16 most influential cars ever made? If you answered Ford, Chevy, VW, Honda, or any other car manufacturer, you are close…but wrong! The 16 most influential cars ever made were the 16 original Hot Wheel cars that Mattel rolled out in 1968. Stacey walks you through the fascinating and unique story of how those little metal cars came to be and how they changed American car culture in a HUGE way. Young or old, you will love the story about the cars that turned living rooms across the country into huge racetracks. Matter-of-fact, we’ll bet you not only remember these cars, but you probably owned a few of them over the years. So, dig out the toy box and put the chores on hold because it’s time to do some Hot Wheels racin’!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: When it comes to off-road vehicles, more is usually better. This is especially true when tires are involved. Today on GEARZ, Stacey takes you through the nuts and bolts of one of the most incredible off-road vehicles ever built…the Gamma Goat. What!?! You’ve never heard of it? Well that’s probably because you were not in the military. Because only the military could dream up an articulating, six-wheel-drive, amphibious monster like this, and still keep it street legal! After that, Stacey walks you through some important safety tips and tricks that you need to know if you are going to be welding in your shop…so lock and load and strap in ‘cuz it’s all coming at you today on GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey goes where all of us have been before to pull an old derelict SEMI TRUCK(’69 International) out of a quiet junkyard to demonstrate the steps necessary to get an old, neglected vehicle running again. From rat’s nests to chicken poop, it’s all here as Stacey slowly coaxes the old truck back to life. This show definitely drives the point home that if something like this can be revived, there’s NOTHING that you should be afraid to tackle as long as you are armed with a set of tools and a sense of adventure! Go get ‘em !

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: The Speed Racer Story and the Real Mach 5
programme.desc: Stacey digs into one of the most influential cars and cartoons in our history -- Speed Racer and the Mach 5. This show not only takes you thru the history of the cartoon, but also its cultural impact on multi-generations as well. But that’s not all, Stacey manages to “borrow” the real Mach 5 and put it thru the paces against Racer X and other challengers. If you’ve never crossed the line between fact and fiction, real and imagined, we invite you to do it now with Stacey. Go…Speed Racer…Go!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Cash for Clunkers & Easy Upgrades for Fuel Economy
programme.desc: One of the most controversial things to come along recently was the “Cash for Clunkers” program, but do you really know the whole story? Well after this show of GEARZ you will! But Stacey doesn’t just reveal the problems with the Cash for Clunker program, he also demonstrates real solutions available in the aftermarket to address the fuel mileage problem with simple upgrades that ANYBODY can do. If you are tired of feeling like a victim and are ready to do something about your vehicles performance and fuel economy…this is the show to see!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Aftermarket vs. OEM Parts – Welding Techniques for Replacing Sheet Metal
programme.desc: Stacey answers some top questions from viewers as he compares OEM parts to their Aftermarket replacements. Which is the best quality? Which is the best deal? After you see this show, you will know the answer to those questions and a lot more. Then Stacey reveals the tips and techniques involved in welding in replacement sheet metal. If you never thought you could do this kind of major surgery yourself, this show will change your mind and encourage you to get out there and try it! So what are you waiting for? Get movin’!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: ’67 Mercury Cougar disassembly – GMP Diecast story
programme.desc: So you’ve got a new project and you are dying to dig into it huh?..... Well, before you touch it, there are some tips and trick you ought to know before you blow it all apart and end up getting lost in a project you can’t ever finish. Stacey shows you those tips and tricks as he rolls in a Classic ’67 Mercury Cougar and starts methodically taking it apart to prepare it for some wild modifications down the road. If you are considering a project, or are already deep into one, you have got to see this show. Then we take an in depth look at the world of die cast models, as we put the spotlight on GMP and check out their incredible models. So whether you are into toy cars, miniature cars, or the real thing, this episode of GEARZ has something for everybody!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Herobox ’59 Ford Stepside Pickup - Welding Table
programme.desc: Stacey rolls in a ’59 Ford Stepside Truck that is being built by the Herobox organization to help raise awareness for their goal of sending Heroboxes to all of our men and women serving in the Military. It’s a great cause and a great truck and both need to be seen! The truck has already received a lot of modifications, but Stacey adds his special touch by installing custom wood in the bed, trying out a new roll-on bedliner, and sinking some cool 60’s Corvette taillights into the rear fenders. If you’ve got an old truck and have been wondering how to bring the bed and fenders up a notch… this show will definitely give you some ideas! After that, Stacey shows you just how important having the proper work table is, and the kind of things you can do if you have one. It’s all about the tools… it’s all about the techniques… it’s all about GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: If you ask any Gearhead what they dream about doing, being a Blue Angels Jet pilot or an Astronaut will be right at the top of the list. But what is really involved in being a pilot for the Blue Angels? Well today Stacey takes a look at the incredible history of the Blue Angels, and where they are today. Then as only GEARZ can do, Stacey takes you into the cockpit and allows you to experience first hand the incredible experience of flying with the Blue Angels. If sitting on top of thousands of horsepower and flipping inverted at the speed of sound sounds like fun to you… then hold on, because you are in for the ride of your life! If you’ve ever wondered what it was like to be a part of the Blue Angels, and wondered if YOU could ever be a part of the team… this is one show you can’t miss!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Project Heavy Metal & Duramax Diesel Engine Install/Drivetrain
programme.desc: Stacey rolls in that old International Cab over Truck, and starts a project called Heavy Metal. The project not only showcases people that work with their hands for a living, but also represents the Navy’s Blue Angels precision flying team. The first order up for business is to get some serious power into the truck and that involves Stacey stuffing a hot-rodded Duramax Diesel engine and Allison transmission into the old beast. If you have ever wondered what it takes to retro-fit a big diesel engine into a project, and if there are parts available to make it happen… this show will not only answer those questions, but also encourage you to do it!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Return of the Rat Roaster/Paint and Interior
programme.desc: IT’S BACK!!! The Rat Roaster ’32 Ford roadster rolls back into the GEARZ shop wearing a new coat of green paint and sporting a custom interior… but how did it get that way? Simple, It went for a visit to the Hot Rod Institute in South Dakota, and Stacey takes you there too, as he shows you what makes this tech school so much different than all the others out there. Then Stacey continues putting the finishing touches on this hot ’32 Ford roadster as it makes its way down the final stretch to completion. The baddest car in the valley in 1969 is about to come to life!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: The V8 Interceptor – Front suspension on a ’67 Mercury Cougar
programme.desc: One of the most popular cars of the Muscle car era… the Mercury Cougar has been one of the most overlooked cars in recent decades. All of that changes as Stacey rolls in a solid ’67 Cougar, dubs it the “V8 Interceptor”… and begins to completely change the front suspension to get rid of the stock shock towers and turn this little old lady’s car into a corner-carving, road-gripping beast. But wait!... you can’t cut out the shock towers can you!?! Yes you can!... and Stacey goes in-depth on not only how to do it, but also the installation of a complete TCI independent front suspension. If you own or want to own a classic Mustang, Cougar, Fairlane, or other 60’s Ford and have always wished you could get rid of those stock shock towers to get more room in the engine compartment, this is the show for you.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: V8 interceptor – Boss 429 History - Boss Nine Engine and 6spd Transmission Install
programme.desc: Stacey takes a look at one of the most incredible engines that Ford ever built, the boss 429. But instead of leaving you WISHING you could have one, he shows you where you can actually GET one…. the legendary Jon Kaase. After that he rolls the V8 Interceptor, Cougar back into the shop and gives you 780 reasons why this car is called the Interceptor. With all that new-found room under the hood. Stacey stuffs in a 520ci, 780 horsepower, Boss Nine engine and a 6speed manual transmission to back it up. If you didn’t think modern performance parts would fit in a classic muscle car, this show proves they can! But there’s more to it than that, it’s the rebirth of Ford’s hemi and finally an answer to all those Ford fans who have wondered what could have been if the Boss engine had continued. The Boss V8 Interceptor is in the house!!!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: V8 Interceptor Rear Suspension - West Coast Classic Cougar - Michigan Tech
programme.desc: Stacey rolls the V8 Interceptor/Cougar back into the shop and begins upgrading the rear end and rear suspension to handle all the massive power that has been stuffed under the hood. The parts are flyin’ as in goes a custom 3-link torque arm suspension, a 9” Ford rear end, and a tubular sub-frame to prevent the car from flexing. If you have a classic Mustang or Cougar, you’re gonna want to see this! Then Stacey shows you where to get parts for your Mustang or Cougar project by paying a visit to a special salvage yard that specializes only in…you guessed it…Classic Cougars! If you’ve ever wondered where to get those special parts….now you know. After that we take a trip to Michigan Tech to check out their amazing testing facilities and put some actual products to the test. It’s all here…. and it’s all GEARZ!

Helped by their friend Laconia, the Smurfs may be able to resist Chlorhydris' evil plan...

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: The Answer Smurf
programme.desc: Nobody ever listens to Brainy Smurf's advice, and when Papa Smurf is away and Brainy feels he's in charge, he decides he's going to be the one with all the answers. There is a magic formula in Papa Smurf's Book of Spells that ensures everyone in the Village of the Smurfs is going to ask for Brain's opinion. Will Papa Smurf fall into Gargamel's trap? Will their enemy catch all the Smurfs? Will this story have a happy ending?

programme.desc: Jealous of the attention Vanity Smurf receives when he breaks his toe, Jokey Smurf feigns sickness in hopes of getting recognition. Unfortunately, his ploy turns against him and instead of loving care all he receives is the proverbial pound of curse.

When Hogatha learns of this, and also discovers the existence of Grandpa Smurf, she feels confident that she can surprise the Queen with her capture. Of course, Hogatha must first capture Grandpa Smurf...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf's had enough. The Smurflings and Sassette keep on telling tales about him with unpleasant results. He therefore concocts a magic formula, taken from Papa Smurf's books of spells, which makes the little Smurfs' tails grow longer and longer every time they tell tales. What he hasn't counted on is that Gargamel now has a way of catching the Smurflings.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hogatha disguises herself as the Golden Smurf Award to catch the Smurfs in order to use them as the main ingredient in her beauty cream. Vanity convinces her to try his recipe and before long, the wicked sorceress is covered with mud and sent careening over the hills into Gargamel's house.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf has decided to dedicate himself to the wellbeing of his fellow Smurfs. He is going to cure them of all ills… With a little help from the evil Gargamel!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Simon is lost in the forest and in search of his parents. Simon is the son of a couple of giants. The Smurfs try to bring him home, but then Gargamel interrupts the party.

programme.desc: Mother Nature always does her best, but this time she's gone wrong. Her wand gets the wrong results and she accidentally damages the Autumn harvest. Now the Smurfs and all the forest animals face a lean and hungry winter. The only place where the Smurfs could get food would be the Land of Plenty. But Gargamel steals the famed Horn of Plenty to lure the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In an effort to find out where the Smurfs' secret diamond stash is hidden, Gargamel pretends to be their friend. When he shows his true, wicked self, Papa Smurf works a magic spell to save his little Smurfs from the vicious clutches of the evil wizard.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In an effort to give Papa some quiet time, Brainy uses one of Papa's spells to create a magical sound barrier around the village. Papa cannot reverse the spell and sends the Smurflings, who are trapped outside the Village, to a noisemaker. Baby takes a bottle of sound from the noisemaker, which breaks the barrier.

programme.desc: Handy Smurf has saved Clumsy from a horrible fate. Clumsy swears eternal devotion to his savior and does his best to repay his debt… With awkward results. A clever scheme is needed to stop Clumsy's well-meant catastrophes...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf organizes a crew to sail to Smurfberry Island because Gargamel has killed all of the trees except one to trap the Smurfs. Gargamel follows them, but once more fails to catch them because the Witch of Smurfberry Island sends her nose-eating seagulls after them.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When the emergency call rings, all the Smurfs in the Village drop what they are doing and run to hear the news. But when Vanity Smurf calls for an assembly so that the Smurfs can admire his new hat, it is too much. They send him on his way out of the village, and Vanity has the bad luck of meeting Lofty, the Elf, who suggests a horrible mud bath...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.sub-title: The Little Orange Horse With Gold Shoes
programme.desc: Sliding down a rainbow, a little winged horse loses a golden shoe. He meets the Smurfette and she helps him look for his lost horseshoe. They fall in love somehow, for who could be unmoved by the charm of a little orange horse... Or of a Smurfette?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Poor Lazy! All he wants is a good night's rest. But no, all the Smurfs throw a party for him and, what's more, he gets dragged into a silly argument about painting giant Bigmouth's toes a bright tangerine red... It's a long, sleepless night for poor Lazy Smurf!

programme.title: Have You Smurfed Your Pet Today?
programme.desc: The Smurfs get so involved with Handy's new toy that they forget to feed Puppy. Gargamel lures Puppy into a cage with food and holds him for ransom – the Smurfs' magic secrets. The Smurflings distract Gargamel with the toy long enough to rescue Puppy and they vow to never neglect him again.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As the Smurfs prepare for the Festival of the Stars, Gargamel plants a creature in their midst that smells so rotten that he can easily be traced to the Smurf village. Papa Smurf realizes that Born Rotten is from another planet, and he instructs Feathers to return him to his home before Gargamel finds them.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy Smurf is the one who fixes everything that needs mending in the Village of the Smurfs. But are his efforts really appreciated by the other Smurfs? Not at all. At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The wicked wizard Gargamel asks the sorcerer Balthazar for a recipe to capture the Smurfs. It involves kidnapping Mother Nature to stop the arrival of Spring. Luckily, the Smurfs save the day.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf has decided to dedicate himself to the wellbeing of his fellow Smurfs. He is going to cure them of all ills… With a little help from the evil Gargamel!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs love truffles but truffles belong to the Trolls and the Trolls live under Truffle Troll Mountain, where in the shadows of the lake lurks the Thing with No Name...

programme.desc: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: Wedding Bells For Gargamel

Even Papa Smurf is changed into a pathological liar. What is more, the Spirit of the Scales chain Gargamel and Sassette to each other, and together they have to replace the Topaz of Truth....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs help a fairy queen outwit the evil fairy Fallon who tries to take away her son's magic rattle.

programme.desc: Smurfette promises Mother Nature that if she creates a blue rose Smurfette will never cut it. But when the white rose becomes blue, Smurfette becomes white. programme.desc: Clumsy and Smurfette are captured by the wicked Bombast, who plans to exhibit them in his sideshow. Papa Smurf hurries to their rescue and using the bungling Gargamel for interference is able to rescue his Smurfs.

programme.desc: What is that strange talking frog that Morlock the Wizard sends all of Prince Theodore's soldiers to catch? Is it a demon frog, as he says, or something else? programme.desc: The Smurflings free the Smurfs from the clutches of Gargamel just in time to get Baby to its first word ceremony. Baby utters the word « Gargamel ». Papa Smurf says that this word indicates that Baby will one day become the Great Chief, as he is aware of the dangers in life.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Al descubrir que su compañera de equipo Lexa es objeto de un experimento encubierto que la está controlando, el equipo de Mutante X busca al médico responsable.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Cuando la vida de Jesse está en juego, Brennan debe conectarse con él y guiarlo a través de recuerdos pasados que han compartido para salvar su vida.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Mutante X debe evitar que un científico clone mujeres para usarlas como esclavas en su club de hombres ultra exclusivo.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Las sospechas de Lexa llevan a Mutante X a revelar un campo de exterminio itinerante, que se presenta como un circo para refugiados mutantes y el enemigo de Mutante X dentro del Dominio.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Muchos de los misterios que rodean a Mutante X se revelan cuando Lexa y Jesse son capturados por el Dominio, y el equipo, junto con Adam, entra a rescatarlos.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Un empático mutante que huye de unos misteriosos agentes del gobierno es rescatado por un equipo de compañeros "Nuevos Mutantes", el grupo conocido como Mutante X.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Brennan es capturado y cae bajo el control de Eckhart, quien se ve obligado a trabajar contra los Nuevos Mutantes.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Mutante X acude en ayuda de una adolescente Mutante Nueva perseguida por rusos porque tiene el secreto de una nueva arma que tiene como objetivo a los mutantes.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Un nuevo mutante es secuestrado de su familia, y Mutante X se propone recuperarlo y averiguar cuál es el interés de Eckhart con él.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Cuando una plaga que solo afecta a los mutantes se desata, Adam y Eckhart aceptan trabajar juntos para encontrar una cura.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Eckhart busca un mutante que pueda absorber energía, uno con el que Brennan se involucre románticamente.

programme.desc: El equipo se encuentra con un mutante que mata a otros mutantes al drenar su energía y también puede volver a la vida después de ser asesinado.

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Amplify: USVI
programme.sub-title: Amplify USVI: The Global Stage: St. Croix Blowing Up
programme.desc: Host Naydyeyah Acoy-Thomas traces the rich, layered history of St. Croix’s musical roots, uncovering the deep ties to African, European, and indigenous Taíno traditions. Featuring voices like Asta Williams, Willard John, Rashidi Clenance, and Vio International, the episode explores how genres such as quelbe, calypso, and scratch band music were born from the island’s complex past. Through storytelling, performances, and cultural insight, Naydyeyah reveals how the rhythms of resilience and celebration continue to echo through generations.

programme.title: Amplify: USVI

programme.desc: Host Naydyeyah Acoy-Thomas traces the rich, layered history of St. Croix’s musical roots, uncovering the deep ties to African, European, and indigenous Taíno traditions. Featuring voices like Asta Williams, Willard John, Rashidi Clenance, and Vio International, the episode explores how genres such as quelbe, calypso, and scratch band music were born from the island’s complex past. Through storytelling, performances, and cultural insight, Naydyeyah reveals how the rhythms of resilience and celebration continue to echo through generations.

programme.title: Amplify: USVI
programme.sub-title: Amplify USVI: Sound of Revolution: Music as a Voice for Change
programme.desc: Host Naydyeyah Acoy-Thomas uncovers the revolutionary spirit woven into the music of St. Croix, where sound has long served as a rallying cry for justice and identity. Through the powerful perspectives of Mada Nile, Ras Attitude, Ras Bach, the Ay-Ay Cultural Dancers, and Kevin Williams, this episode explores how artists have used music to confront oppression, celebrate resilience, and inspire change — from the island’s historic struggles to its modern-day movements.

programme.desc: Was it time for James Franklin to go at Penn State? On this episode of Others Receiving Votes, Sports Illustrated's Pat Forde and Bryan Fischer are joined by former longtime College Gameday Reporter Gene Wojciechowski to break down the firing of Penn State Head Coach James Franklin after the teams loss to Northwestern, their third straight. They also breakdown whether Penn State is in position to be a championship contender in the Big Ten and for the College Football National Championship before giving their thoughts on who Penn State should turn to next, bringing up Curt Cignetti of Indiana and the tough choice he could have this offseason. After that, they give out their Midseason Awards for Heisman, Flop, Surprise, Coach and Team of the half season while also talking about some of the dumbest ideas that were brought up by the masses during the first half of the college football season. They finish things off with a view at some of the big games this weekend, giving their picks and some background on each matchup including a few games that could have College Football Playoff implications in USC vs. Notre Dame, BYU vs. Utah and Alabama vs. Tennessee.

programme.title: Viral Wild
programme.desc: Tag along with these good samaritans on some of the most heart-pounding animal rescues.

programme.title: Viral Wild
programme.desc: The Aquatic life holds a lot of surprises, here are a few for you to enjoy

programme.title: Storm Hunters
programme.desc: A white monster charges up the Eastern Seaboard, and 80 million citizens are in its path.

programme.title: Duality: A Graffiti Story
programme.desc: Graffiti artists rise from tagging to acclaim, shaping culture and landing major brand deals.

programme.title: NF Forward: Being Kylie Earl
programme.desc: Kylie suffers from a rare genetic disease called Neurofibromatosis which from birth affected her left eye. She has never been able to see from it, as she got older the plexiform tumors caused her eye to be removed. Against odds Kylie, a bubbly 16yr old is a high performing athlete, a back spotter in the Texas Elite Cheer team. While facing crippling mental blocks and battling low muscle tone because of her condition she preserves in a sport that favors not only physical aesthetics but requires precision, strength and flawless technique.

programme.title: After Skid Row
programme.desc: After Skid Row documents the journey of Barbie Carter as she navigates the transition to housed life following the brutal reality of a decade on the streets. Her unique story and compelling character help to both demystify and deeply personalize a homelessness epidemic that continues to swell across Los Angeles. Directed by Lindsey Hagen.

programme.title: Mississippi River Styx
programme.desc: An enigmatic drifter with terminal cancer lives his dream of floating the Mississippi Rive on a ramshackle houseboat - until locals start to question his story. Directed by Tim Grant and Andy McMillan.

programme.title: What The Psychic Saw
programme.desc: Before filmmaker Matthew Palmer’s birth, his mother visited a psychic. This is a film about that visit and the tragic - and fateful - prediction the psychic made on that day. Directed by Matthew Palmer.

programme.title: Salam Neighbor
programme.desc: Two filmmakers fully embed themselves in a Syrian refugee camp, providing an intimate look at the world's most dire humanitarian crisis. Directed by Chris Temple and Zach Ingrasci.

programme.title: Tracing Light
programme.desc: A dive into the subconscious minds of Brooklyn based installation art duo, Hovver. Katherine Brice and Chris Lunney take natural light formations and isolate them in their art - this is their process. Directed by Alex Ramsey.

programme.title: Crypto Farmers - Censored
programme.desc: Can you make money from manure? - Farms are struggling to get by in this modern world. Farmers are forced to diversify their income steams in order to survive. With a remarkable new invention from a young entrepreneur farmers in rural Wales are now heating up piles of cow manure to power crypto mining rigs.

programme.title: All Things Metal
programme.desc: Three blacksmith brothers operate an iron forge where they explore craft, music, and a life of creativity together.

programme.title: When The LAPD Blows Up Your Neighborhood
programme.desc: Tensions rise on a busy street as news organizations and local residents witness an extremely volatile situation turn into a literal powder keg. Directed by Nathan Truesdell. A DOCUMENTARY+ Original film.

programme.title: NF Forward: Aidan
programme.desc: Aidan Fraser has undergone 20 major surgeries and been on five different chemotherapies in 17 years due to NF. Yet, despite the magnitude of this challenges, Aidan is a video blogger, YouTube channel host, CTF staff member, and fervent NF trailblazer with an incredible story of exceptional resilience. Directed by Jamoody Jaafar.

programme.title: Tale of the Tape
programme.desc: A feature doc tracing mixtape culture and the DJs who revolutionized Hip Hop.

programme.title: Free to Care
programme.desc: A single mother with a passion for nursing, Lisa Creason wanted the freedom to pursue her dreams. When an unjust law prohibited her from doing so, she took the fight into her own hands and ended up opening doorways for thousands like her.

programme.title: Paperboy Love Prince Runs for Mayor
programme.desc: Rapper and street performer Paperboy Love Prince takes on the political elite in the race for NYC mayor. Directed by Owen Dubeck.

programme.title: Imillaskate: The Cholita Skaters of Bolivia
programme.desc: In the mountains of Bolivia, a collective of Indigenous women challenge gender stereotypes through skateboarding—tearing down the notoriously steep streets wearing traditional pollera skirts. - For ImillaSkate, skateboarding is more than a sport—it’s a statement of resilience and empowerment in a machismo society. And now, they’re building a skate park and community center to inspire the next generation of girls. Directed by Rebecca Basaure.

programme.title: The Heartbeat Of Life
programme.desc: In the sunlit hills of Sicily, artisan Francesco transforms goatskin into tambourines, each drum a reincarnation of life’s rhythm. Through his soulful craft, he gives voice to the cycle of life and death, calling his creations his children before releasing them into the world. Joined by Peppe, a passionate percussionist devoted to preserving Sicily’s ancestral beat, they weave a timeless narrative of tradition, connection, and the enduring heartbeat of the drum across generations. Directed by Guisseppe Malpasso.

programme.title: VOYAGEURS - Chapter One
programme.desc: Ultra Runner Cortney Haile makes a fierce bid to crush her personal best at the Javelina Jundred.

programme.title: Lazarus
programme.desc: Lazarus is a short documentary following Lazarus Chigwandali, a street musician with Albinism from Malawi as he teams up with a London-based music producer to record his debut album. Directed by David Darg.

programme.title: ifine
programme.desc: Set in Sierra Leone’s Kono district, ifine is a documentary that explores the beauty of Blackness through the eyes of youth coming of age amid a skin bleaching epidemic. Directed by Ebony Gilbert and - Adisa Septuri.

programme.title: Acid Attack: My Story
programme.desc: In 2012 Naomi Oni was attacked with acid – leaving her with life-changing injuries. The film combines archive footage, and stylized recon with interviews with Naomi, the police, the medics who continue to treat her, and her family and friends. This film reveals the story behind one of the most shocking and bizarre acid attacks in recent years.

programme.title: Horndribbles
programme.desc: Step into the handmade world of Horndribbles, a - documentary where puppeteer Lucas Richards builds - more than characters—he builds connection, - community, and meaning through the art of puppetry. Directed by Savannah Warrick.

programme.title: Hands Up, Chin Down - Censored
programme.desc: Hands Up, Chin Down is a short documentary about Jerry Mitchell, one of the most respected coaches in amateur boxing. Based on a series of raw audio recordings and lasting exactly the length of a round of boxing, the film is a conceptual study of the coaching process with its strange mix of brutality and care. World premiere at Sheffield Doc/Fest 2018.

programme.title: The Rocket On The Roof
programme.desc: Curiosity gets the best of a man trying to solve the mystery of a rocket curiously perched on a nearby roof. Directed by Ryan Maxey and Josh Polon.

programme.title: Sasquatch Odyssey: The Hunt for Bigfoot
programme.desc: Four men’s 40-year hunt for the legendary Bigfoot of the Pacific Northwest.

programme.title: Knuckleball
programme.desc: A documentary that showcases baseball's most unpredictable pitch - follow the journey of the last professional knuckleball pitchers. Tim Wakefield, a 17-year Red Sox veteran, and Mets up-and-comer R.A. Dickey, with just four other living knuckleballers, shine a light on their remarkable brotherhood and the shared pursuit of honor and craftsmanship. Directed by Annie Sundberg.

programme.title: Ode To Desolation
programme.desc: There used to be thousands of fire lookout posts across the US, but now, because of the advancement of satellite technology, there are about 60 left. Jim Henterly holds his post as the eyes and ears of the historic Desolation Peak Fire Lookout - in an effort to preserve the human narrative. Directed by Lindsey Hagen.

programme.title: Missing in Brooks County
programme.desc: Two families search for their loved ones who went missing in the fields of Brooks County, Texas. On their search they meet vigilante ranchers, human smugglers, humanitarian activists, and Border Patrol agents, all of whom are locked in a proxy version of the national immigration debate. Directed by Lisa Molomot and Jeff Bemiss.

programme.title: A View From The Window
programme.desc: An immersive glimpse of a school day through the eyes of deaf children. Follow a third grade class at the California School for the Deaf in Fremont as they learn about everything from marine life to police harassment. Directed by Christian Filippone and Azar Kafaei.

programme.title: NF Forward: Teaqua & Jada
programme.desc: Jada Smoot is a lively, sweet 11-year-old just starting middle school who likes to swim, bike and spend time with her friends. Her mother, Teaqua, is starting a new job with United Airlines and enjoys reading. Both share the love of their close-knit family. Jada and Teaqua also share NF. With amazing spirit, Jada and Teaqua draw strength from each other to navigate these rocky waters.

programme.title: Gotta Groove Records
programme.desc: A short film on the history and resurgence of vinyl records from the perspective of an artist focused pressing plant in Cleveland, Ohio. A hero story about grit, manufacturing and warm tones. Directed by Nick Cavalier.

programme.title: School Of Fish
programme.desc: “School of Fish” offers an intimate portrait inside one family's seasonal salmon rituals and their connection to the Bristol Bay Fly Fishing and Guide Academy, where local youth are empowered through fly fishing to serve as guides and conservationists. Can the next generation step up to defend the most prolific salmon run left on earth? Directed by Colin Arisman and Oliver Sutro

programme.title: The Magic Of Chess
programme.desc: Filmed at the 2019 Elementary Chess Championships at the Nashville Opryland resort, a group of children share their insights about the benefits of chess. Directed by Jenny Schweitzer Bell.

programme.title: This Is Not Financial Advice
programme.desc: Glauber Contessoto gambles his life savings on a joke cryptocurrency. Two months later, he becomes “The Dogecoin Millionaire” and an internet legend. While it might seem easy to get rich online, it’s even easier to lose it all. Directed by Chris Temple and Zach Ingrasci.

programme.title: The Horror Crowd
programme.desc: A revealing insider doc spotlighting Hollywood’s horror community.

programme.title: NF Forward: Off The Breaks
programme.desc: Travis has lived in the fear of breaking his bones most of his life. From the age of 2 a tumor, caused by a rare disease called Neurofibromatosis, has been growing from his spine down his leg. Directed by Rory K. Mcharg.

programme.title: Betty Feeds The Animals
programme.desc: Betty loves animals, she loves them so much that everyday she puts 30 bowls of food outside of her home to feed them. She feeds skunks, raccoons, cats, foxes and the occasional opossum. This is her story. Directed by James P. Gannon.

programme.title: Still/Life
programme.desc: A cultural renaissance in the historic city of Yangon, and a rare glimpse into a country in extreme transition. Directed by Josh Hayward.

programme.title: Abundance
programme.desc: During the largest food crisis in a century, a group of college students catalyze a national movement to end food insecurity in the U.S. Directed by Owen Dubeck.

programme.title: Finding Gulo
programme.desc: "Finding Gulo" follows a backcountry ski guide & field biologist who attempt to document an elusive population of wolverines in Washington's Cascade Range. When our government fails to act, can citizen science save endangered wildlife from climate change? Directed by Colin Arisman And Tyler Wilkinson-Ray

programme.title: Kims Video
programme.desc: Physical media reigns supreme in KIM’S VIDEO, a tribute to the iconic video store in NYC that inspired a generation of cinephiles before it mysteriously closed its doors and sent its legendary film archive to a small Sicilian village for “safekeeping.” What starts as an homage to cinema quickly becomes a rescue mission to ensure the eternal preservation of the beloved video collection. Directed by Ashley Sabin and David Redmon.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: The 1985 Texas Memorial Invitational is nearing its conclusion at the Sam Rayburn Reservoir in Sam Rayburn, Texas. Watch along as the top anglers in the world compete to see who ascends to hoist the trophy and take home the glory.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: Sam Rayburn Reservoir brings the top anglers in the world together for the 1986 Texas Invitational in Sam Rayburn, Texas. Will Ron Shearer go back-to-back, or will another angler take the crown and leave as the champion of this Bassmaster Series Tournament.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: The 1986 New York Invitational on the St. Lawrence River continues the Bassmaster Series in Clayton, New York. Jimmy Houston and Mickey Bruce take part in an all-time race to see who takes home the top prize and cements themselves in the legacy of the New York Invitational.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: It's the final day of the 1984 Missouri Invitational on Truman Lake in Warsaw, Missouri. Charlie Ingram and Larry Williams go head to head from wire-to-wire, but only one angler can walk away as the champion. Don't miss the final moments to see who is crowned champion.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: The Bassmaster pros take on the sprawling waters of Kentucky Lake in this late-season showdown. With cold fronts rolling in and bass holding tight to structure, Jim Kirkpatrick rises above the field with a strategic approach and steady execution, landing nearly 44 pounds of bass.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: The 1987 Texas Invitational is an all-time classic, taking place on the Sam Rayburn Invitational in Sam Rayburn, Texas. Watch along as top anglers compete to see who can make the most of a high-pressure situation and emerge victorious.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: The Bassmasters tour heads north to the historic Hudson River for a thrilling invitational in Catskills, NY. Watch elite anglers battle tidal currents and urban waters in pursuit of bass glory. David Fenton emerges victorious with a razor-thin margin, outlasting legends like Larry Nixon and Fish Fishburne. Hosted by Ray Scott, this episode delivers intense competition, expert commentary, and scenic river views.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: The 1985 Super B.A.S.S. IV Tournament becomes an instant all-time classic as Hank Parker and Gary Klein have a showdown on the St. Johns River in Palatka, Florida. Tune in to see who emerges victorious and cements themselves in Bassmaster history.

programme.title: The Bassmasters - 1980s
programme.desc: The Super Invitational on Kentucky Lake in Paris, Tennessee brings one of the most dominant performances in Bassmaster Series history. Tune in to see who gets hot and leads wire-to-wire, casting a pitch-perfect weekend and taking home the top prize.

programme.title: Peak Performance - John Crews
programme.desc: The Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Johns River went to ‪@JohnCrews‬ as he led wire to wire to win his second career Bassmaster Elite Series event. Watch his week from behind the lens as he strived for another major tournament victory as a professional fisherman.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Buddy Gross
programme.desc: The Marathon Peak Performance at the Harris Chain of Lakes went to Buddy Gross who came from behind to win his second career Bassmaster Elite Series event. Watch Gross go to work and win big in Florida.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jason Christie Classic
programme.desc: A story a decade in the making unfolded at the 2022 Bassmaster Classic when ‪@Christiefishing‬ notched his first Classic victory at Lake Hartwell. Watch Christie's Marathon Peak Performance from start to finish as he climbed the mountain in the sport of bass fishing and achieved the biggest win in the sport.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Drew Cook
programme.desc: Bassmaster Elite Series pro Drew Cook (‪@thecutlinetv‬) has been a strong competitor since joining the Elite Series in 2019, but a win has eluded him early in his career.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jason Christie
programme.desc: Jason Christie led three days of the Elite Series event at the Sabine River and rode a great two days of fishing to the winners circle in his return year to the Bassmaster Elites. He is the Marathon Peak Performance at the Sabine.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Lee Livesay
programme.desc: Walk on the wild side with Lee Livesay and his entire week at Lake Fork as he looked to go back to back on his home lake. Livesay was the local favorite with the most amount of knowledge at Lake Fork, but sometimes that can bite you. In the Marathon Peak Performance of the Event, Livesay wins his third Elite Series title and fourth overall Bassmaster victory in just a span of 18 months.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brandon Lester
programme.desc: ‪@BrandonLesterFishing‬ fished a flawless week at Pickwick Lake for the 6th stop of the 2022 Bassmaster Elite Series season. Lester took the title and won his first Elite Series title and his second B.A.S.S. win this year. Congratulations to Lester, the Marathon Peak Performance at Pickwick.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jay Przekurat
programme.desc: As a 23-year old rookie on the Bassmaster Elite Series, Jay Przekurat made history. In the Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Lawrence River, Przekurat becomes the youngest Elite Series champion and also breaks 100 pounds for the first time in history for a smallmouth bass event. Watch his week unfold in Clayton, NY.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Austin Felix
programme.desc: Austin Felix had an impeccable smallmouth record in Bassmaster Elite Series events prior to Lake Oahe, but the Minnesota pro went to another level after four successful days in South Dakota. In the Marathon Peak Performance at Lake Oahe, watch Austin Felix take home his first tour-level victory with Bassmaster.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Bryant Schmitt
programme.desc: Bryan Schmitt is one of the winningest anglers in professional fishing and his great track record is noted on grassy river fisheries. Schmitt ended 2022 with a big victory on the Mighty Mississippi River in La Crosse, Wisconsin. Watch his stellar week in the Marathon Peak Performance of the tournament.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brandon Palaniuk
programme.desc: In this Marathon Peak Performance, we take a look at Brandon Palaniuk's amazing 2022 season en route to his second Angler of the Year title.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Tyler Rivet
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance from Lake Okeechobee, follow Tyler Rivet as he closes in on his first Bassmaster Elite Series title. Rivet is a 5th year Elite Series pro who started his career in college at Nicholls State where he formed a Bass Team and fished in every Bassmaster National Championship during his five years in school.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Joey Cifuentes
programme.desc: First year Bassmaster Elite Series pro Joey Cifuentes dominated the Lake Seminole Elite event and took his first pro-level victory. Cifuentes outlasted the field with a four-day total of 85 pounds, 2 ounces. In this Marathon Peak Performance you can watch his winning week.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jeff Gustafson
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 2023 Bassmaster Classic, watch Jeff Gustafson's dominant performance as he wins for the second time on Fort Loudoun and Tellico. Gussy started strong with 18-8 and 17-3 over Day 1 and 2, but on the final day he needed every bit of his lead to hold off the hard-charging field of anglers looking to make up weight and try to win the Bassmaster Classic

programme.title: Peak Performance - Drew Benton
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 2023 Lake Murray Bassmaster Elite Series, watch Drew Benton's tournament as he notched his 2nd Bassmaster victory. Benton started the week in 2nd place, jumped into the lead, fell to 10th and then completed a comeback of over 5 pounds on the Final Day to win.

programme.title: Peak Performance - LukePalmer
programme.desc: Bassmaster Elite Series pro Luke Palmer has been dubbed as one of the most consistent pros early in his career. His first four years all found him in the 20’s for Angler of the Year and while he’s shown signs of his ability, wins have eluded him. At Santee Cooper he has his Marathon Peak Performance as he follows up a 4th last year, with a win in South Carolina in 2023.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Will Davis Jr.
programme.desc: In his Marathon Peak Performance of the week, watch Will Davis Jr. win his first Bassmaster Elite Series title in dramatic fashion on his home body of water. Davis won by just 2 ounces over Brandon Palaniuk, making it the closest margin of victory since Toledo Bend of 2011.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brock Mosley
programme.desc: In his 8-year Bassmaster Elite Series career, Brock Mosley has been so close to major titles but fallen just short with 5 2nd place finishes and even more Top 10’s. Watch Mosley put four great days together on his way to his first Elite Series title at the 2023 Folds of Honor Bassmaster Elite at the Sabine River and take home the Marathon Peak Performance!

programme.title: Peak Performance - Joey Cifuentes
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 7th stop of the 2023 Bassmaster Elite Series season, Joey Cifuentes takes the title at Lake St. Clair by going against the grain. Cowboy Cifuentes is a Rookie on the Elite Series but with two wins in 2023, he has wowed the fishing world.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Kyoya Fujitia
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance for the 8th stop of the 2023 Bassmaster Elite Series season, watch Kyoya Fujita take the title at Lake Champlain for the first B.A.S.S. win of his career. The young Japanese prodigy stormed to 5 Top 10's in his Rookie season.

programme.title: Peak Performance -Patrick Walters
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Lawrence River, watch as Patrick Walters wins his 2nd Elite Series victory and breaks the 100-pound mark for the 3rd time in his career.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Trey Mckinney
programme.desc: One week after turning 19 years old, Trey McKinney became the youngest Bassmaster Elite Series Champion after landing 130 pounds, 15 ounces at Lake Fork for the 2nd stop of the season. Watch his week unfold in this Marathon Peak Performance feature.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Justin Hammer
programme.desc: ‪@justinhamnerfishing‬ followed his passion and that dream led him to the Bassmaster Elite Series. After a few years on the Elites, he was in the catbird seat of the 2024 Bassmaster Classic where his lifelong dream came true and he became the World Champion of bass fishing. Watch his week unfold at Grand Lake O' the Cherokees in Oklahoma.

programme.title: Peak Performance - John Garrett
programme.desc: The Marathon Peak Performance for the third stop of the Elite Series season features John Garrett and his impressive week at the Harris Chain of Lakes. The former College Champion and current Elite Series rookie led wire to wire and got his first blue trophy in just his 3rd event of the season.

programme.title: Peak Performance -Patrick Walters
programme.desc: Through just 5 years on the Bassmaster Elite Series, Patrick Walters has an incredible resume. He added another accolade with a win at Lake Murray, doing so in impressive fashion. Congratulations to ‪@patrickwaltersfishing5121‬, he is the Marathon Peak Performance at the 5th stop of the 2024 season.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Takumi Ito
programme.desc: Taku Ito got another blue trophy on the Bassmaster Elite Series with his big win at Smith Lake. Relive his week in Alabama where he conquered spotted bass en route to his second Elite Series win since joining the top ranks in 2020.

programme.title: Peak Performance - CliffPrince
programme.desc: Watch Cliff Prince's winning week at Wheeler Lake in this edition of the Marathon Peak Performance of the tournament. Prince found a magical spot where the fishing was on fire the first two hours of every tournament day and it lasted all four days en route to his first blue trophy on the Bassmaster Elite Series. The area was 4 to 5 feet deep and Prince maintained a low profile and fished his chatterbait around grass and over a hard spot without using his forward facing sonar.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Ed Loughran III
programme.desc: Ed Loughran, who is also a practicing attorney, notched his biggest fishing achievement by winning the Bassmaster Elite Series event at Lake Champlain. He leaned on both largemouth and smallmouth en route to his first career victory. He is the Marathon Peak Performance for the 8th event of the 2024 Elite Series season.
